Container.Name: Dipolar App
Container.Overview: Dipolar (Streamio IPTV) web app: React UI + nginx. Proxies /api to the Dipolar Server container. Open this port in your browser for the full app.
Container.Description: Web UI for Dipolar. Requires the Dipolar Server container running with name "dipolar-server". Build both images from the repo: docker compose build. Then add Dipolar Server first, then add this container (Unraid applies the link so the app can reach the API at hostname "server").

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Host port for the web app
